title: Inline HTML with `<` or `>` inside a quoted attribute value is escaped as text
spec:
This is the Python-Markdown library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -q`. Inline HTML tags whose quoted attribute value contains `<` or `>` are not recognised as HTML. The opening tag is escaped and shown as text, while the closing tag is passed through, which produces broken output. Input: `markdown.markdown('Anything')` Expected: `

Anything

` Actual: `

<span data-tip-txt="Ctrl">Anything

` HTML allows `<` and `>` inside quoted attribute values, and other parts of the library already accept them. Other tags and single-quoted values are affected the same way: `Text x end` should render as `

Text x end

`.
acceptance: The reported input renders as expected
Inline tags with `<` or `>` in single- or double-quoted attribute values are passed through as raw HTML
